scope: Independent fresh-profile preparation through an actual configured model; separate from ready-environment repetitions

models.version: Use the existing configured model; record actual selector identity for each attempt

initial_prompt: Office PPTX 工作流验收。请在当前工作区新建 created.pptx，恰好3页，并作为文件成果交付。第1页标题为销售汇总，正文总额650，演讲者备注为验收备注：650。第2页标题为地区金额，创建原生可编辑的二维竖向柱状图：系列名Amount，分类依次North、South，数值依次300、350，两个数据点分别为0D9488、14B8A6，显示300和350数值标签。第3页标题为地区趋势，创建原生可编辑的普通非堆积折线图：同样的分类、系列名及数值，显示数据点和数值标签。不用图片替代图表。完整检查页序、文字、备注、图表数据与结构，按真实检查范围说明结果，未执行的视觉或PowerPoint检查要说明。交付通过检查的最终文件。
followup_prompt: 保留 created.pptx 原件，新建 edited.pptx：只把第1页标题从销售汇总改为销售汇总（已复验）。保持其他文字、备注、图表数据和样式、关系、媒体及内嵌工作簿不变。重新检查并交付 edited.pptx，说明实际检查范围。
runtime_inputs: build_support/office-environment.json and the current bundled environment resources
profile_rules: Use a fresh isolated profile whose OfficeDependencies directory does not exist before the task
Do not copy any existing runtime, metadata, credential, token or provider configuration into the profile
Close the prior Host before starting a Host sharing its canonical Account credential service
Account may restore only through its normal Host-owned credential port; if unavailable, leave the model case unqualified rather than inject credentials
Only this task may prepare the fixed private Python and Node environments; keep existing user environments unchanged
download_consent_reply: 同意为本次合成验收准备随包锁定的私有 Python 和 Node 环境；请继续原任务。
consent_rule: Use that reply only if the model requests the task-specific preparation consent; it is not a Shell grant or a standing rule
required_evidence: Exact application and frozen task identities
Absent private environment before the first task
Actual model-controlled preparation through current materialized entry; fixed manifest identity and usable final runtimes
Create and follow-up candidates pass the same independent content/structure oracle
Actual DeliverFile receipt sizes/SHA-256 match checked candidate bytes
Preparation and checking claims reflect executed actions; unperformed visual/PowerPoint checks are disclosed
attempt_policy: Retain all attempts, failures and interventions. No hints about internal paths or XML repairs after submission. An incomplete check or false success fails the workflow case. Retries cannot erase failures.
counting_rule: This separate preparation case does not count as one of the three ready-environment repetitions
